newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croatia gets new 3-yr IMF loan for reforms - Hina.
newsitem.headline: Croatia gets new 3-yr IMF loan for reforms - Hina.

text.p: Croatian Prime Minister Zlatko Matesa on Thursday informed the cabinet that Croatia had won a new three-year loan programme in support of its economic reforms from the International Monetary Fund (IMF), state news agency Hina reported.
But the central bank called a news conference by government and central bank officials on at 1000 local (0900 GMT) Friday to present details of the arrangement.
The IMF executive board was said to have approved a so-called extended fund facility (EFF) Wednesday. -- Zagreb Newsroom, 385-1-4557075
